description: Digicontent Limited operates as a digital media and content solutions company in India. The company offers digital news ecosystem, such as hindustantimes.com, livemint.com, and livehindustan.com that covers news, business, politics, lifestyle, entertainment, and current affairs. It also operates platforms, including HT Auto, HT Tech, Healthshots, and Mint Money that provides content across automobiles, technology, health and wellness, and financial market products. In addition, the company offers source for movie reviews and ratings website through www.desimartini.com; and photo library. It is also involved in the aggregation and creation of audio and multi-screen videos; distribution of in-house creative and niche celeb-based content to mobile and digital users; and operates an audio feed that plays music inside across various stores. In addition, the company engages in the dissemination of news, knowledge, information, entertainment, and content of general interest in English, Hindi, and any other language through various digital and economic media; and management of advertising time and space on its news websites. The company was formerly known as HT Digital Ventures Limited and changed its name to Digicontent Limited in October 2017. Digicontent Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in New Delhi, India.
